maintenance_led.reason: Sells Premier Protein shakes, Dymatize powders and PowerBar; consumable food products used up, not maintenance or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Consumers buy protein shakes and powders through retail, club, e-commerce and foodservice channels; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from selling more Premier Protein and Dymatize products and launching new flavors; not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer protein shakes and powders are easily swapped for competing brands; no retraining, qualification or regulatory switching cost.
